page_title: BUR 2-1 BRE | Burnley v Brentford 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's the end of the match.
90+13' Shandon Baptiste (Brentford) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren Bond had an easy-decision to make.
90+10' Ivan Toney (Brentford) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+9' A pass from Wilson Odobert (Burnley) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
90+7' Goal, no wait, Brentford have a goal disallowed due to a foul.
90+5' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zeki Amdouni trots off the pitch and is replaced by Josh Brownhill (Burnley).
90+4' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
90+3' Burnley work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Burnley.
90+1' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+1' Zanka (Brentford) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arijanet Muric, who smothers the ball.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
88' Substitution. David Datro Fofana walks off the pitch and Lyle Foster (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.

87' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Arijanet Muric, who pulls off a comfortable save!
85' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) is adjudged offside.
84' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!

83' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) alters the score to 2:1. He latched on to a good cross into the box from Shandon Baptiste, steering his header from close range off the post into the bottom left corner. Arijanet Muric was helpless.
83' Ivan Toney (Brentford) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
83' The resulting corner from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is cleared.

82' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
81' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
80' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Neal Maupay (Brentford) heads on.
80' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Vitaly Janelt as he is replaced by Shandon Baptiste (Brentford).
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is replacing Yoane Wissa.
79' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Mathias Jensen is replaced by Neal Maupay (Brentford).
78' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
74' A brilliant cross into the box finds Zeki Amdouni (Burnley), who directs his header towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
73' The shot by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mark Flekken.
73' Ivan Toney (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
71' Ivan Toney (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Brentford will take a corner kick.
70' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
69' A substitution has been made. Jacob Bruun Larsen goes off and Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) comes on.

69' Mark Flekken doesn't have to worry about this one. David Datro Fofana plays a pass into the feet of Wilson Odobert (Burnley), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes well wide of the left post.
68' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.

67' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Mark Flekken blocks the shot with his legs.
65' One of the players from Burnley times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
62' 2 - 0 Goal David Datro Fofana (Burnley)! David Datro Fofana (Burnley) was put through by Wilson Odobert and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
61' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Burnley comes to nothing.
61' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. It will be a corner kick for Burnley.
60' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Here is a change. Mads Roerslev Rasmussen is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
59' It will be a substitution. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is ready to enter the pitch as Frank Onyeka walks off.
56' The game is interrupted now, Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
54' Ivan Toney (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out for a corner. Brentford can continue in their attacking effort.
52' Sander Berge (Burnley) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
51' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
48' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
48' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
47' Ivan Toney (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Darren Bond blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Darren Bond blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+6' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) dribbles into the box, but Mark Flekken is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

45+5' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.

45+3' Wonder save! Yoane Wissa (Brentford) picked up the ball and hit a beautiful curling shot from the edge of the box. Arijanet Muric saw it late but somehow got his fingers to the ball to keep it out.
45+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Charlie Taylor (Burnley), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.

45' A short pass finds Wilson Odobert (Burnley). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
45' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
41' Lorenz Assignon plays a short pass through to David Datro Fofana (Burnley) inside the box, but he scuffs his effort well wide of the left post.
41' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) commits a foul and Darren Bond immediately signals a free kick.
38' The Burnley players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
34' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
32' Half-chance! Sander Berge (Burnley) plays a pass into the box, but Mark Flekken reacts well to snuff out the attack.
30' Ivan Toney (Brentford) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Yoane Wissa, but Arijanet Muric displays great awareness to stop him.
28' The ball possession is 63:37.
27' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.

24' Ivan Toney (Brentford) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the bottom right corner, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save. The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
24' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Darren Bond blows his whistle for a foul.
23' Vitinho (Burnley) is penalised for a foul. Darren Bond had a clear view and blows his whistle.
21' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
18' Frank Onyeka (Brentford) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
17' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Burnley was in an offside position.
16' The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
16' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Charlie Taylor (Burnley). Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
13' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
12' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
11' Burnley take a short corner kick.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mark Flekken into the bottom left corner.
9' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is going to take the penalty!

8' It's a foul from Sergio Reguilon (Brentford). Surprisingly, the referee comes and pulls out a red card. It was a very harsh one and Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) complains, but it's no use of course. The decision has been made.
8' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
5' Referee Darren Bond makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
4' Vitinho (Burnley) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
4' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
3' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Mathias Jensen (Brentford). Darren Bond saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Brentford will kick-off.
Darren Bond is introduced as the referee for today's match.
